content: विरञ्ज् €1 €4 <ab>U.</ab> ²1 To grow discoloured or soiled, be coarse or rough; केशा अपि विरज्यन्ते निःस्नेहाः किं न सेवकाः <ls>Pt. 1. 82</ls> (where it has sense 2 also). .²2 To be discontented or disaffected, to dislike, hate; चिरानुरक्तोऽपि विरज्यते जनः <ls>Mk. 1. 53</ls>; <ls>Bh. 2. 2</ls>; श्रीर्निष्कुष्यति लङ्कायां विरज्यन्ति समृद्धयः <ls>Bk. 18. 22</ls>. .²3 To become disgusted with the world and hence to renounce all worldly attachments. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} To colour, dye.
